import numpy as np, requests, re, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session()
def parse(t):
    o=[]
    for l in t.splitlines():
        if l.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')) and l[16] in (' ','A'):
            o.append(dict(rec=l[:6].strip(),name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),ch=l[21],
                num=int(l[22:26]),xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]),b=float(l[60:66])))
    return o
B62="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3

Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2

K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2

F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1

ls=B62.strip().split('\n'); hdr=ls[0].split(); M={}
for l in ls[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for h,v in zip(hdr,p[1:]): M[(p[0],h)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return M.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-10**9
    Mx=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG,float); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG,float); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG,float)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mx[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); pY[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1])
            c=[Mx[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); Mx[i,j]=c[k]+s; pM[i,j]=k
            c=[Mx[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge,Iy[i-1,j]+go]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); Ix[i,j]=c[k]; pX[i,j]=k
            c=[Mx[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); Iy[i,j]=c[k]; pY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([Mx[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); pr=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: pr.append((i,j)); st=pM[i,j]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif st==1: st=pX[i,j]; i-=1
        else: st=pY[i,j]; j-=1
        if i<0 or j<0: break
    return pr[::-1]
def fasta(a): return ''.join(S.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,Sv,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T));R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T;return R,qc-R@pc

X=parse(S.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/9FVU.pdb',timeout=120).text)
A=[a for a in X if a['ch']=='A']; Bs=[a for a in X if a['ch']=='B' and a['rec']=='ATOM']
m=S.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q5U4P2',timeout=60).json()[0]
D=parse(S.get(m['pdbUrl'],timeout=120).text)
sA,sD=fasta('Q12797'),fasta('Q5U4P2'); pairs=nw(sD,sA)
caA={a['num']:a['xyz'] for a in A if a['name']=='CA' and a['rec']=='ATOM'}
caD={a['num']:a['xyz'] for a in D if a['name']=='CA'}
cur=[(i,j) for i,j in pairs if j in caA and i in caD and j>=560]
for cut in [6.,4.,3.,2.5,2.5]:
    P=np.array([caD[i] for i,j in cur]);Q=np.array([caA[j] for i,j in cur]);R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
    dev=np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1);cur=[c for c,dd in zip(cur,dev) if dd<cut]
P=np.array([caD[i] for i,j in cur]);Q=np.array([caA[j] for i,j in cur]);R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
for a in D: a['t']=R@a['xyz']+t

# pLDDT per residue of ASPHD1
pl={}
for a in D: pl.setdefault(a['num'],a['b'])
dxyz=np.array([a['t'] for a in D])
clash={}
for b in Bs:
    dd=np.linalg.norm(dxyz-b['xyz'],axis=1); k=int(np.argmin(dd))
    if dd[k]<3.0:
        r=D[k]['num']; clash[r]=min(clash.get(r,99),float(dd[k]))
cl=pd.DataFrame([dict(ASPHD1_res=f"{[a['res'] for a in D if a['num']==r][0]}{r}",closest=round(v,2),pLDDT=round(pl[r],1)) for r,v in sorted(clash.items())])
print('ASPHD1 residues clashing (<3.0 A) with the superposed Factor X EGF-like substrate:')
print(cl.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nclashing residues: {len(cl)}; median pLDDT {cl.pLDDT.median():.1f}; fraction pLDDT<70: {(cl.pLDDT<70).mean():.2f}")
hi=cl[cl.pLDDT>=70]
print(f"high-confidence clashing residues (pLDDT>=70): {len(hi)} -> {', '.join(hi.ASPHD1_res)}")

# pLDDT profile context
reg={'1-70 N-term':(1,70),'73-95 TM':(73,95),'96-188 linker':(96,188),'189-384 DSBH':(189,384),'385-387 C':(385,387)}
print('\nmean pLDDT by region:')
for k,(a1,a2) in reg.items():
    v=[pl[r] for r in pl if a1<=r<=a2]
    print(f'  {k:16s} n={len(v):3d}  mean {np.mean(v):.1f}')

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
rs=sorted(pl); ax[0].plot(rs,[pl[r] for r in rs],lw=1,color='#34495e')
ax[0].axhline(70,color='#c0392b',ls='--',lw=1,label='pLDDT 70')
ax[0].axvspan(189,384,color='#2980b9',alpha=.12,label='DSBH domain 189-384')
for r in clash: ax[0].plot(r,pl[r],'o',ms=3,color='#e67e22')
ax[0].plot([],[],'o',ms=4,color='#e67e22',label='clashes with substrate')
ax[0].set_xlabel('ASPHD1 residue'); ax[0].set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
ax[0].set_title('AlphaFold confidence, AF-Q5U4P2-F1-v6')
ax[1].scatter(cl.closest,cl.pLDDT,color='#e67e22',edgecolor='k',s=36)
ax[1].axhline(70,color='#c0392b',ls='--',lw=1)
ax[1].set_xlabel('closest approach to a substrate atom (A)'); ax[1].set_ylabel('pLDDT of the ASPHD1 residue')
ax[1].set_title(f'{len(cl)} ASPHD1 residues occupy the substrate site;\n{len(hi)} of them are confidently modelled')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
